payload.title: Google sign-in is the standard: default on, stable Cognito domain from site.json
payload.description: Ryan's firm requirement: CMS sign-in is Google, always. The new Pilobol.us CMS (app dv0pdx67fk80m) fails LOGIN with 'oauth param not configured' because its pool has no hosted-UI domain and no Google provider. Fix the template so a site created from it gets Google by default with a stable Cognito domain (cms.cognitoDomainPrefix in infra/site.json), update synth tests and docs. No AWS changes.
